profile.Name: Hamut
profile.Personality: Driven by a controlled anger. He has searched so long for his wife that he fears she is dead, but he has not stopped.
profile.Backstory: Slavers took his wife. He tried to join the Anti-Slavers and was turned away as too angry.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Measured words over deep anger; bitter about the Anti-Slavers' refusal.
